Presales and proposals · Start · Tested
In 1 minute

Discovery call summary

Marcos · Sales Development Coordinator

Six SDRs at a software company run 70 discovery calls a week and hand the opportunity to the account executive in three lines of free text.

When it runs
At the end of each discovery call, when the recording and the transcript become available in the SDR's folder, before moving the opportunity to the Meeting scheduled stage
What it delivers in production
One handoff summary per call, in fixed fields with quotes from the transcript, ready minutes after the call and reviewed by the SDR before it reaches the executive.
Who decides
Drafts; the SDR reviews and hands off
Effort
Calibrate on 20 transcripts; 4 weeks reviewing
Set up5 steps · 4 ready files
Step 1 of 5 · Prepare

Create the folder in Drive with two empty subfolders

Do this
  1. 1In Google Drive, create the folder
  2. 2Inside it, create Input and Output
  3. 3Leave both empty until the test
Done when

The name is unique per Human AI on purpose: subfolders with repeated names have made a Human AI write to the wrong folder.

Show content
# Discovery call script (presales)

The SDR covers these 8 topics. The summary compares the call with this list.

1. Pain: the problem in the prospect's words.
2. Current setup: systems, spreadsheets, people and frequency of the process.
3. Volume: how many items the process handles per month (for example, how many physicians receive a payout or how many entries). The number of people on the team is setup, not volume.
4. Budget: amount, range or existence of funds.
5. Decision: who decides, who influences, who approves technically.
6. Timeline: date or event that makes the prospect act.
7. Competition: other solutions evaluated.
8. Success criterion: how the prospect will measure whether it worked.

## How to count a gap
- Covered topic: the SDR asked or the prospect talked about the subject on the call, even if the answer is "I don't know" or "we don't have one".
- Gap: a topic nobody addressed on the call.
- The lead record and the form do not cover a topic: they serve as context in the header, never as a quote.
- A sentence said by the SDR is not the prospect's pain, even if the prospect agrees with "yeah" or "sort of".

## Consent
The recording notice and the prospect's acceptance must appear by 00:02:00.

## Rules with no leeway
- A decision maker named by the prospect counts as identified, even without joining the call. INCOMPLETE HANDOFF for the decision maker only when nobody said who decides.
- A next-step date (confirm the meeting by Friday) is not TIMELINE. TIMELINE is only the reason to act stated by the prospect on the call.
- Talk outside the business (soccer, for example) does not appear in any field.

## Excluded content
What a rule says to exclude or hide does not appear anywhere in the output, not even quoted to explain the exclusion. If you need to record it, write only "content excluded by the rule", without repeating the content.

## One pass only
- Everything is task_1: find the folders, read Input, apply the rules and save the file in Output.
- Do not build a plan with separate steps (locate, read, classify, write, save). A 1-task plan.

Show content
[Discovery call, 2026-11-04, 10:00 to 10:31, Google Meet]
[00:00:08] C. Vieira (SDR): Good morning, Marina. Thanks for your time.
[00:00:40] C. Vieira: Before we start: this call is recorded so I can pass the context to the account executive. Is that OK with you?
[00:00:47] Marina: That's fine, go ahead and record.
[00:01:30] C. Vieira: I saw your team is doing well in the championship, huh? They won yesterday.
[00:01:36] Marina: Don't get me started, I almost lost my voice at the stadium.
[00:03:10] C. Vieira: I imagine you lose a lot of time with the physician payouts.
[00:03:16] Marina: Yeah, sort of.
[00:05:12] Marina: The real problem is that closing the payouts takes four days and there is always a physician complaining about a wrong amount.
[00:06:40] Marina: Today each unit sends a spreadsheet, finance puts it all together and checks it against what came from the scheduling system. Two people do this every month.
[00:09:05] C. Vieira: And budget, do you already have something set aside for this?
[00:09:18] Marina: There are 2027 project funds, but I don't know if we can use them for this. The CFO is the one who knows.
[00:11:30] C. Vieira: Who takes part in the decision?
[00:11:42] Marina: I take the proposal, but Rogério, the CFO, is the one who signs. And IT has to approve any integration with the scheduling system.
[00:14:20] Marina: We already saw a demo of another platform in September, but we found it complicated.
[00:16:05] C. Vieira: Can I send you a case study of a similar network?
[00:16:10] Marina: Sure.
[00:17:30] C. Vieira: Can I set up a meeting with you, the CFO and our executive?
[00:17:41] Marina: I'll talk to Rogério and confirm the date with you by Friday.
[00:18:02] C. Vieira: Deal. Thanks, Marina.

Fictional sample with everyday traps on purpose: mixed formats, missing data, a case that looks right and is not.

Step 5 of 5 · Use

Replace the sample with your data

Do this
  1. 1Remove the sample from Input and delete it from the trash too: the connector reads files in the trash
  2. 2Replace the sample in the knowledge base with your company's text
  3. 3At the end of each call, save the Google Meet transcript with timestamps and speakers in the Input folder, together with the lead record, and click ▶
  4. 4Replace the script in the knowledge base with your team's discovery script
  5. 5The SDR checks the summary and pastes it into the CRM; after a few runs without corrections, connect Slack to deliver it in the pair's channel, with approval before sending
Done when

Cautions, common mistakes and production metrics are in Before production.

Before production

Cautions

The summary only states what is in the transcript, with the minute cited; no inferring budget from company size or decision maker from title. A call without recorded consent to record is not transcribed, and the SDR does the handoff by hand. The Human AI does not give a qualification score or recommend discarding: it flags gaps and the SDR decides whether to go back to the prospect.

Common mistakes

  • Recording as budget the amount the SDR suggested and the prospect did not dispute; silence is not confirmation.
  • Confusing who attended the call with who decides; the economic buyer is rarely in discovery.
  • Leaving out the competitor because the prospect did not say the name.
  • Handing off the opportunity with the gaps listed without going back to the prospect.

Metrics

MetricRangeSource
Meetings returned by the executive for missing informationfrom 30% to 10% to 15% in 8 weeksestimate based on the described routine
Handoff fields correct in the SDR's review90% or more, the calibration acceptance criterionestimate based on the described routine
SDR time to record the handofffrom 15 to 20 minutes of writing to 3 to 5 minutes of reviewestimate based on the described routine

Sample production output

Fictional sample. Handoff for the call of 2026-09-02, SDR M. Prado, lead Grupo Horizonte Educacional (form of 2026-08-28, title Operations Coordinator).

STATED PAIN: the monthly student attendance close takes 6 days and 3 people (min 04:12: "we close attendance on day 6 and leadership wants it on day 2").
CURRENT SETUP: spreadsheets per campus consolidated by hand; the network's academic system has no attendance module (min 07:40).
BUDGET: not stated; signal: "there is budget approved for a system in 2027, but we want to bring it forward" (min 15:05).
DECISION: the coordinator influences; the one who signs is the administrative director, not present (min 16:30). IT needs to approve the integration (min 17:10).
TIMELINE: start of the semester in 2027-02 (min 18:02).
COMPETITOR: mentioned receiving a proposal from another vendor in July, without naming it (min 19:45).
AGREED NEXT STEPS: meeting with the administrative director in the week of 2026-09-08; SDR sends integration material to IT.
GAPS: number of campuses and students not asked; not confirmed whether the 2027 budget can be brought forward or only reallocated.
